repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 五篇文獻均非支持 Digoxin 治療十二指腸潰瘍：兩篇關於 PPI 藥理（PMID 11117653、14664653）；一篇為 Digoxin 毒性在潰瘍患者的臨床表現（PMID 20496812）；一篇為 EBV 研究（PMID 11496304）；一篇為 cimetidine 對 Digoxin 藥動學的交互作用（PMID 3743626）。整體為 DDI 與共病關係，無治療性證據。
無任何臨床試驗或文獻支持。Digoxin 無已知促進幽門括約肌功能或減少膽汁逆流之機轉。純屬 TxGNN 圖譜預測，缺乏生物學合理性基礎。
疾病本體論已標記為「obsolete」（廢棄術語），不應作為獨立再利用靶標。無臨床試驗或文獻支持。即便以缺血性卒中易感性討論，Digoxin 在房顫以外的卒中預防無直接證據。
低 α 脂蛋白血症（HDL 降低）涉及 ABCA1/LCAT/ApoA-I 代謝路徑，與 Digoxin 的 Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase 抑制機轉無已知交集。無任何支持性文獻或試驗，為純預測。
純合子家族性高膽固醇血症為 LDL 受體功能缺失，治療靶點（PCSK9、LDL 受體、HMG-CoA 還原酶）與 Digoxin 機轉無關。無臨床試驗或文獻，預測可信度極低。
NSIAD 由 AVPR2 激活突變（Arg137Cys/Arg137Leu）引起持續性抗利尿作用。Digoxin 抑制腎小管 Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase 可能影響電解質排泄，但現有無文獻或試驗支持其用於 NSIAD，且在已有低鈉血症患者中使用存在電解質紊亂安全疑慮。

literature.abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction occurs almost with the same frequency as heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. The diagnosis is based on echocardiography with evidence-based ejection fraction over 50 %, or with left atrial enlargement and left ventricular hypertrophy, and specification of natriuretic peptides. BNP 35 pg/ml and NT-proBNP 125 pg/ml are considered the limits of the norm for chronic heart failure. The treatment of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

literature.title: Analysis of The 2024 ESC/EACTS Guidelines For The Management Of Atrial Fibrillation.
literature.journal: Journal of cardiothoracic and vascular anesthesia
literature.abstract: The 2024 European Society of Cardiology guidelines for atrial fibrillation (AF) emphasize a patient-centered approach to management, structured around the AF-CARE pathway: Comorbidity and risk factor management (C), Avoiding stroke and thromboembolism (A), Reducing symptoms through rate and rhythm control (R), and Evaluation and dynamic reassessment (E). This framework ensures that comorbidities such as hypertension, heart failure, diabetes, and obesity are effectively managed to prevent disease

literature.title: Ivabradine for treatment of heart failure.
literature.abstract: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) is associated with a worse outcome. Heart rate (HR) is related to outcome in HFrEF. Ivabradine selectively inhibits If (funny) channels in a concentration-dependent manner reducing HR.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 間接機轉路徑：Digoxin 控制 AF 心室率 → 減少血栓栓塞風險 → 降低心臟栓塞性卒中發生率。此路徑有生物學合理性，且有 Phase 4 RCT（AF 心率控制）和回顧性世代研究（PMID 35420260）支持；但 Digoxin 並非直接作用於卒中病理機轉（非抗凝、非抗血小板）。Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase 在血管平滑肌的作用（PMID 37877226）提供額外但尚待探索的機轉假說。
